summary: Iteration 9 - Phase 3 (Reports w/ global date range + new reports, Site Visit calendar) and Phase 4 (CallerDesk mocked integration). Backend: 52/52 pytest pass (/app/backend/tests/backend_test_v9_reports_callerdesk.py) - all 9 report endpoints 200, invalid date & start>end -> 400 on every report, daily = one row per day (30 for June) and >366 days -> 400, user-status has 11 stage columns + total consistent, not-interested phone masked for manager, lost-reasons sums match, calls outgoing/missed (bad call_type 422), executive scoped to own data (summary == admin assigned_to=priya, user-status/executives/activity own only), skyline admin sees zeros. CallerDesk: status configured=false provider twilio; manager PATCH settings 403; exec 403 on dashboard/call-logs/campaigns; provider=callerdesk -> POST /leads/{id}/call returns pending_credentials mock=true + callerdesk_calls row + lead activity; actor without phone (priya) -> 400; call-logs filters + masking for manager + no _id/raw; campaigns create (400 when no valid numbers), list counts, PATCH, start dials batch of calls_per_minute (2 -> pending_credentials, 2 remain pending), pause, cancel (pending -> cancelled), 404 for unknown; webhook ANSWER/42s creates lead + connected incoming log, NO ANSWER matches same lead -> dnp + missed_call notification to owner (verified in DB), unknown org 404. Regression v8: 48/48 pass (incl. previously failing cross-org assign). calling_provider restored to 'twilio' (verified). Frontend (Playwright, desktop 1920): Reports page all testids present, presets update start/end, Apply refreshes KPIs (6mo 55 leads/112 calls -> 7d 1 lead -> ytd 146 calls), calls & missed KPI dialogs open with report-calls-table, sources CSV downloads, lost reasons chips, user-status/NI/exec sections render. Site Visits calendar default, prev/next/today, day panel with visit links navigating to lead, agenda toggle and back. CallerDesk page: dashboard banner + 6 stats, all 5 tabs for admin, settings toggle/status/webhook/key inputs, dialer search + call -> 'pending' toast, campaign create/start/pause/view numbers/cancel, logs filters; manager sees nav + no settings tab + masked phones; exec has no nav. dash-call-report-card is on the Overview 'Action items' tab and links to /callerdesk/logs.

minor.issue: Returns 500 on malformed JSON body and on non-numeric talk_duration (int('abc')). Wrap request.json() in try/except -> 400 and parse duration safely.
Public, unauthenticated and no webhook secret configured by default -> anyone knowing ?org=tasko can create leads/fake call logs/notifications. Recommend requiring secret once keys are added.
Campaign start and scheduler dial via CallerDesk regardless of calling_provider; an 'active' campaign keeps logging calls after provider switched back to twilio.

pending_credentials (mock) CallerDesk calls are counted as outgoing calls in reports (summary/activity/daily/calls) - inflates telemetry. Also executive scope uses assigned_to only (co-owned leads excluded).

ui_bugs.issue: Executive can open /callerdesk directly (no route guard) - page renders tabs/zeros and shows 2x 'Insufficient permissions' toasts. Should redirect/403 page for executive.
Expanded numbers panel (cd-camp-numbers-<id>) is not refreshed after Start/Pause/Cancel - shows stale PENDING after cancel. Also shows phone twice when lead_name missing.
/callerdesk/settings as manager renders blank content with no tab selected (no message/redirect).
calendar-day-<date> testid uses toISOString() of local midnight -> off by one day in timezones east of UTC (e.g. IST). Use local y-m-d formatting.

issues: Time column cut off horizontally in max-w-3xl dialog
report-user dropdown lists all users for executive though backend ignores it - hide for executive
date inputs use native browser date picker (no testids) instead of shadcn calendar; same for report-start/report-end

action_items: Guard /callerdesk route for executives (redirect) to avoid permission-error toasts
Webhook: return 400 for malformed JSON / bad duration instead of 500
Skip/stop campaign dialling when calling_provider != callerdesk (or block start)
Refresh open campaign numbers panel after start/pause/cancel
Consider excluding pending_credentials calls from report call counts
Fix calendar-day testid timezone, hide report-user filter for executives
critical_code_review_comments: callerdesk.py webhook: payload parsing not wrapped, int() on untrusted input -> 500s
callerdesk.py dashboard 'today' computed in UTC, not org local (IST) - counts shift at 5:30 AM IST
reports.py loads up to 20000 activity docs in memory per request for several endpoints concurrently (8 parallel calls from Reports page) - use aggregation pipelines for scale
reports.py /reports/sources without start/end returns all-time while other reports default to last 30 days - inconsistent defaults

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (all requested flows work; exec route guard + minor UI issues)
